applicant.name: Dr. Hannah Egger
applicant.organisation: Salzburg Institute of Clinical Pharmacy (university research group)

purpose: Individual-level data are crucial for our research and student teaching on asthma treatment patterns, especially for adults who have no anticholinergic inhaler.
question: Among patients with asthma aged 18 and over, how many have no active anticholinergic inhaler, by age band?
definitions: Asthma = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J45.
Anticholinergic inhaler = ATC code starting with R03BB.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per band: patients with asthma, how many of them have no active anticholinergic inhaler and that share in %, one decimal.

expected.reason: The purpose is allowed (Art. 53). The application does not show why anonymised statistics are not enough, so pseudonymised records are not justified (Art. 66(2)). It is answered with anonymised statistics instead (Art. 68(3), Art. 69).

judge.why: Rule 5: calling individual-level data crucial is not an explanation of what will be done with records, and the Report definition is counts and shares per age band, so Rule 4 is not met.
